statement_made: I'm not going to fall into that trap of trying to be smarter than the process and pass on good players to acquire picks. We've got to get good football players into the equation.
event_description: Dolphins GM explaining his draft philosophy regarding the value of established players versus accumulating late-round picks.

statement_made: We're in a situation here where these draft picks are going to come in and they're going to play early... we do not have a ton of established players on this team.
event_description: Managing expectations for the 2026 rookie class and the level of immediate contribution expected.

statement_made: My stutter is part of who I am, but it's not all of who I am... I'm the best receiver in this draft. Period.
event_description: Writing an open letter to NFL GMs ahead of the draft to discuss his character and skill set.

statement_made: When I put on those cleats and that helmet, none of the other stuff followed me out there... Out there it was just — what can you do? And what I could do was run.
event_description: Reflecting on how football provided an escape and a voice during his childhood.

statement_made: Ready to be that chess piece for the Giants. Whether it's rushing or dropping back, I'm going to make plays.
event_description: Commenting on his defensive versatility after being selected by the New York Giants.

statement_made: I want to be the guy that sets the tone for the Commanders defense. Range and size—I'm bringing it all to DC.
event_description: Discussing his transition to a modern second-level playmaker for Washington.

statement_made: I'm quicker than fast, and I know how to get open. Philadelphia is the perfect place to showcase my game.
event_description: Addressing his route-running polish after being drafted by the Eagles.

statement_made: I bring proven experience and the ability to align anywhere in the secondary. I'm a Swiss Army knife for this defense.
event_description: Highlighting his versatility following his first-round selection by the Bears.

statement_made: Some 25-year-olds are more immature than some 18-year-olds... we grade the player for what they do and what they are, not their age.
event_description: Bucs GM discussing his evaluation criteria regarding prospect age in the NIL era.

statement_made: My immediate reaction was it's just time to run it back again... it's time to go to work with my brothers again.
event_description: Reacting to being drafted by the Dolphins alongside former Texas teammates.

statement_made: I'm not underrated or anything like that, I just feel like I'm coming in with the right chip on my shoulder.
event_description: Reflecting on being a sixth-round pick and his motivation moving forward.

statement_made: Football is so important to me just because it's a sport that I can really release all my inner feelings out on another man and then just have fun with it.
event_description: Describing his personal connection to the game of football.

statement_made: Effort going to outlast skill every time. So just going out there with the approach that I'm going to give 100 percent.
event_description: Reiterating his philosophy on work ethic during his introductory Dolphins media session.

statement_made: I didn't want to go somewhere and put uncertainties in the air... exactly what me and my dad preached, I feel like it came to life.
event_description: Explaining why he chose to stay at San Diego State despite transfer portal interest.

statement_made: Baltimore, let's work. Grateful for the opportunity to compete and show what I can do.
event_description: Confirming his UDFA deal with the Baltimore Ravens via social media.

statement_made: The work doesn't stop. Happy to have that fifth-year option picked up, but the mission remains the same.
event_description: Commenting on the Chargers' decision to exercise his fifth-year option.

statement_made: Excited for a fresh start in Carolina. Ready to compete and help this QB room in any way possible.
event_description: Reacting to signing with the Panthers in late April.

statement_made: New York, let's get physical. Fired up to join the Giants and get to work.
event_description: Announcing his signing with the Giants earlier in the month.

statement_made: Houston is a team on the rise. I'm here to bring that veteran leadership to the offensive line.
event_description: Discussing his move to the Texans on a two-year deal.

statement_made: Detroit, we're just getting started. Appreciate the team's belief in me.
event_description: Reaction to the Lions picking up his fifth-year option.
